  image-security:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        application:
        - onesa-ai-platform-backend
        - onesa-ai-platform-frontend
    steps:
    - name: Verify GitHub-hosted execution and actual visibility
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        EXPECTED_PRIVATE: ${{ github.event.repository.private }}
      run: |-
        test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
        actual=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq '.private')
        test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_PRIVATE" || { echo 'Visibility changed; dispatch fresh validation under the current policy'; exit 1; }
      working-directory: .
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
        ref: ${{ github.sha }}
        fetch-depth: 0
    - name: Build application runtime
      run: docker build -t onesa-security-candidate:ci ./${{ matrix.application }}
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Verify health client success, failure, proxy isolation and timeout
      if: matrix.application == 'onesa-ai-platform-backend'
      run: python3 scripts/healthcheck_smoke.py onesa-security-candidate:ci
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Verify default production image startup and shutdown
      if: matrix.application == 'onesa-ai-platform-backend'
      run: python3 scripts/startup_smoke.py onesa-security-candidate:ci
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Verify native release-image PDF restrictions
      if: matrix.application == 'onesa-ai-platform-backend'
      run: docker run --rm --network none --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges -i onesa-security-candidate:ci
        python - < scripts/release/pdf_image_probe.py
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Scan full runtime, including unfixed vendor advisories
      run: |
        mkdir -p data/security
        chmod 700 data/security
        docker save onesa-security-candidate:ci -o data/security/runtime.tar
        docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e TRIVY_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/trivy-cache -v "$PWD/data/security:/reports" aquasec/trivy:0.75.0@sha256:af6acf9a6b85dfe389a1941505c0ce9efef52a4719635e1a962f022a3d855daa image --scanners vuln,secret --format json --output /reports/runtime.json --input /reports/runtime.tar
        chmod 600 data/security/runtime.json
        python3 scripts/release/image_gate.py data/security/runtime.json
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: 'Release requirement: record tested runtime digest'
      run: python3 ../scripts/ci/runtime_manifest.py --product platform --image "onesa-security-candidate:ci" --output
        "$RUNNER_TEMP/runtime/record.json"
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
      with:
        name: platform-runtime-${{ matrix.application }}
        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/runtime/record.json
        retention-days: 7
        if-no-files-found: error
